freeze_boundary: Defined before any wp11_workcell_v1 live episode (WP-11 Phase D, 2026-10-30). wp10_scenarios_v1-v3 and every v1-v4 task, threshold and record are unchanged; a change here is a new scenario version.

cutting_board.scope: As blademaster_workcell_v1: each task support box becomes a board with the same top surface (local z in [top - thickness, top], same x extent, y widened to half_width_y_m); the PhysX collider equals the visual box and the TLMPM fixture box.

riser.scope: Grey riser from the table top to the board bottom with the original support x/y footprint (100 mm taller than in blademaster_workcell_v1).

wp11_workcell_v1.friction_scope: 'task_material' resolves to task.material.friction when the scenario is applied: 0.3 for the provisional cutting_tasks_v1 material, for PhysX static and dynamic friction of board, riser and table. TLMPM fixture contacts already use the task material friction, so PhysX and TLMPM agree.

home_source.joints: q_home at full float precision from the evidence (ADR 0013 quotes it rounded to 4 decimals)
home_source.hand_pose: Newton forward kinematics of q_home (DualFrankaController, official Franka USD) = panda_hand world pose; the HOME knife edge is this pose composed with the tool profile's hand_from_edge (ruler_knife_v2_y: edge (0, 0, 0.288) m world, hand pointing straight down, blade hanging below the fingers as in /home/ningan/a.png). tests/test_wp11_phase_d.py re-derives it when the Franka asset is present.
home_source.finger_position: 0.0112 m per finger is the C2 collision-check opening on the 22 mm handle; the live reset still starts from ToolGraspConfig.initial_finger_position_m and runs the unchanged physical pregrasp settle.

action_workspace_local_m.scope: Edge-centre safety envelope (control.ActionLimits workspace box) for tasks in this scenario: the ActionLimits default with local z max raised from 0.16 to 0.22 m so the HOME edge (local z 0.188 m) is inside it. Not collision checking; the C2-style motion preflight is.

wp11_workcell_v1.reason: WP-11 all-task workcell (C2 decision): blademaster_workcell_v1 board/riser semantics with the workpiece and supports raised to +100 mm, ruler_knife_v2_y with the tip toward world +y, TRIM at rho = 10 deg. TRIM, vertical CUT, the 20 deg oblique cut and SLICE-PUSH all passed the geometric preflight from the one declared q_home. Episodes reset Franka 0 at q_home with the knife authored in the hand (HOME), Franka 1 at the shared park. Local material geometry and all scoring thresholds are inherited from each task.
wp11_workcell_v1.scope: Allowed for the cutting_tasks_v4 tasks (apply_scenario) and for configured rcs_scene_v1 scenes via supports.workcell.from_scenario. Live acceptance of v4 task ids is a separate phase; this file only declares the workcell.
